intro: Each Cosmic Age moves through four seasons in order. Return here during play for a quick reference.

seasons.title: Spring
seasons.subtitle: Set the Age & Gather Resources
seasons.summary: Spring ushers in a new Cosmic Age. The Agekeeper rolls the Cosmic Age Die. All players determine their Zodiac Sign and receive their personal Cosmic Effect. The Harvest fills everyone's hand — manage your inventory wisely. Ends with Card Lock.

seasons.title: Summer
seasons.subtitle: Trade, Build & Prepare
seasons.summary: The Sun shines brightly as you and your fellow Alchemists focus on your plans. Summer is the perfect time for socializing — bartering over trades, initiating duels, and risking your luck in gambits. In clockwise order, beginning with the Agekeeper, each player takes actions multiple times and in any sequence.

seasons.title: Autumn
seasons.subtitle: Conduct the Great Work
seasons.summary: Alchemists gather around the Crucible to advance their Stones. Two passes in clockwise order: Pass 1 — Leave Stasis and declare Oppositions; Pass 2 — Temper and Fire the Stone. The Agekeeper oversees the Forge.

seasons.title: Winter
seasons.subtitle: Final Actions & Reset
seasons.summary: Winter closes the Cosmic Age. Unlock cards, take the optional Offering to the Age and Fateful Wager, enforce card limits, then Transit the Age: shuffle the Common Deck and pass the Agekeeper's Key clockwise.
